entity.description: A party's current level of a skill. IronStone People (design §10, PE-14; impl-people P18) keeps each evaluation as a PartySkillEvaluation and the accepted level here: an evaluation (sourceEnumId SksEvaluated, or SksManagerEvaluated for a manager's evaluation of a report) sets it, a self-declaration (SksSelfDeclared) only where no evaluation has (mantle.humanres.DevelopmentServices.store#Skill). A row with no source was recorded before People (Projects' skills, a rating) and counts as recorded by staff.

field.name: skillLevel
field.description: The level, a SkillLevel value's number (enumCode, 1 to 5)

field.name: sourceEnumId
field.description: Where the level comes from (SkillSource): self-declared, evaluated or a manager's evaluation; empty for a level recorded before People

field.name: partySkillEvaluationId
field.description: The evaluation the level is from

entity.description: One evaluation of a party's skill (IronStone People design §10, PE-14; impl-people P18): a self-declaration or an evaluation by an assessor, with its level, date and evidence (text, and a qualification it rests on). Kept as history, never changed or deleted; PartySkill holds the accepted level. Written through mantle.humanres.DevelopmentServices.store#Skill.

field.name: assessorPartyId
field.description: Who evaluated: the person themselves for a self-declaration

field.name: partyQualificationId
field.description: A qualification of the person the evaluation rests on

entity.description: A person's qualification: a degree, certificate, licence, work experience, identity document or work permit (IronStone People design §10 Qualifications, PE-14; impl-people P18; refined from the commented sketch, F6). Each has its own identity (a renewal is a new row naming the one it renews, so earlier evidence stays), a type, issuer, reference (the document or certificate number), valid dates and a verification state: submitted (QlVerPending), verified, rejected or revoked by an authorized verifier, never by the person (the state audit-logged with the verifier's reason). An identity document or work permit (QualIdentityDocument, QualWorkPermit and the types under them) needs an expiry, and its reference is read only by the person and HR of an employer of theirs. Its files are on its own content host (PartyQualificationContent, PE-01), never on the Party: the person and HR read them. Staffing reads only whether a verified qualification is valid or expiring (mantle.humanres.DevelopmentServices .check#Qualifications). Written through DevelopmentServices store#Qualification and verify#Qualification.

field.name: title
field.description: Its name, such as the degree or certificate

field.name: referenceNumber
field.description: The document or certificate number; restricted for an identity document or work permit, and kept from every model tool (PE-21); stored encrypted, as PartyIdentification.idValue is (SEC-BOS-116), so nothing finds by it; text-long, as its ciphertext is longer than the number

field.name: fromDate
field.description: Issued, or valid from

field.name: thruDate
field.description: Expires: required for an identity document or work permit

field.name: decisionReason
field.description: Why it was rejected or revoked

field.name: renewsQualificationId
field.description: The earlier qualification of the same person and type this one renews

field.name: reminderThruDate
field.description: The expiry the person was last reminded of, so a reminder is sent once per expiry

entity.description: A file of a qualification: a certificate, a scan of a document (IronStone People PE-01; impl-people P18). The qualification is People's content host, so the file is never on the person's broadly visible Party record; get#RecordLinkInfo and RecordFiles admit it only to the person and a People HR reader of an employer of theirs (mantle.humanres.DevelopmentServices.check#QualificationAccess), and it has no Records-drive folder, so nothing shares it. Written through mantle.humanres.DevelopmentServices.create#QualificationContent.

A line of a person's resume (IronStone People design §4 Employee360 SkillsAndReviews; impl-people P18; refined from the commented sketch, F6): earlier work or education, with the organization, the role and the dates. Read with the person's development record (the person, HR and development staff of an employer of theirs) and changed by the person and an HR or development editor (mantle.humanres.DevelopmentServices.store#ResumeLine).

field.name: organizationName
field.description: The employer, school or other organization

field.name: title
field.description: The role or course

entity.description: A course an employer offers: its title, kind, what passing it grants (a qualification type, valid for validityMonths from the completion; never an identity document or work permit) and whether its completion needs an assessment (a response of a form of the training assessment purpose). Ended (thruDate), it takes no new session; its sessions and enrollments stay. Changed by a development editor of the employer (store#TrainingClass).

field.name: organizationPartyId
field.description: The employer that offers it

field.name: qualificationTypeEnumId
field.description: The qualification passing grants (verified, once per enrollment); empty grants none

field.name: validityMonths
field.description: How long the granted qualification is valid; empty for no expiry

field.name: assessmentRequired
field.description: Y: a completion needs the session's assessment form answered

field.name: assessmentFormId
field.description: The default assessment form of its sessions (DbfpTrainingAssessment)

entity.description: A session of a course: the facts of a WepTraining event (the WorkEffort keyed here, a private event of Commons' calendar whose attendees are its trainer and the people enrolled), its employer, trainer, seats and assessment form. Cancelled with its event (WeCancelled). Scheduled and changed by a development editor of the employer (store#Training).

field.name: trainerPartyId
field.description: Who trains and assesses: a person working for the employer

field.name: capacity
field.description: The seats: enrolled and waiting requests together

field.name: assessmentFormId
field.description: The published form of the training assessment purpose its results answer (the employer's); empty: a result is the outcome and score alone

entity.description: A person's enrollment in a training session, with its own identity: requested by the person (waiting for a People approval of kind PakTraining, PeopleTrainingApproval) or enrolled by a development editor of the employer; approved, refused or withdrawn; the attendance the trainer records; completed once by a passing assessment, which grants the course's qualification once (partyQualificationId) and issues the completion certificate, stored when issued (certificateLocation, its PDF, and certificateHtmlLocation, the page html-print shows, never rendered again). A failed assessment is kept (PersonTrainingResult) and another attempt follows. The status is audit-logged.

field.name: partyRelationshipId
field.description: The employment the training is for

field.name: departmentPartyId
field.description: The department the request routes by

field.name: workEffortId
field.description: The session

field.name: reason
field.description: Why the place is asked for

field.name: partyQualificationId
field.description: The qualification its completion granted, once

entity.description: One assessment of an enrollment, kept: passed or failed, with its score, the assessor (the session's trainer or a development editor of the employer, never the person), the date, evidence and, when the session has an assessment form, the response to it (formResponseId, kept as submitted through its FormInvitation). A failed one is followed by another attempt; the passing one completes the enrollment. Written through complete#Training.

How an employer's reviews run: the steps they ask for (the person's self assessment, the reviewer's assessment always, and whether the reviewer may ask colleagues for feedback), the review form each step answers (a published form of the DbfpReview purpose of the employer; none: the step is a written summary and the reviewer's rating) and the release policy (whether finalizing waits for a People approval of kind PakReview, and whether the feedback is part of what the person reads once released). Dated: ended (thruDate) it starts no new cycle; changed only while no started cycle uses it (a later version is another template). Changed by a development editor of the employer (store#ReviewTemplate).

field.name: selfAssessment
field.description: Y: the person assesses themselves first

field.name: feedbackAllowed
field.description: Y: the reviewer may ask colleagues for feedback

field.name: feedbackReleased
field.description: Y: the feedback, with who gave it, is part of what the person reads once released; N (the default): the reviewer's and development's alone. No feedback is anonymous.

field.name: approvalRequired
field.description: Y: finalizing waits for a People approval (PakReview, PeopleReviewStep: the employer's HR officers unless a rule says otherwise, never the reviewer or the person)

entity.description: A review period of an employer, or of one of its units and the units under it: its template, the period reviewed and the due dates of the self and reviewer assessments. A draft is changed and started by a development editor of the employer (store#Cycle, start#Cycle): starting makes one review for each current employee in its scope, each in its own transaction (a person with no reviewer is named and left out; a later start adds the people left out). Closed only when each review is released, acknowledged or excluded (an exclusion names its reason). The state is audit-logged.

field.name: departmentPartyId
field.description: The unit reviewed (and the units under it); empty: the whole employer

entity.description: A person's review in a cycle (refined from the sketch, F6), for one employment: its reviewer (the manager of the employment's live reporting line when the cycle started; reassigned by development or when the reviewer leaves or the line changes, audit-logged with the reason), its state (audit-logged), the overall rating the reviewer gave, and its release: the employee-visible assessment rendered once when released and stored (its page and PDF), never rendered again, and the person's acknowledgment. The reviewer's private notes (PerformanceNote) are never part of it.

field.name: partyId
field.description: The person reviewed

field.name: partyRelationshipId
field.description: The employment reviewed

field.name: departmentPartyId
field.description: The person's department when the review started (approvals route by it)

field.name: managerPartyId
field.description: The reviewer

field.name: ratingEnumId
field.description: The reviewer's overall rating (PerformanceReviewRating)

field.name: releaseLocation
field.description: The released review's PDF, stored when released

field.name: releaseHtmlLocation
field.description: The released review's page, stored when released

entity.description: A step of a review, with its own identity: the person's self assessment, the reviewer's assessment, or feedback the reviewer (or development) asked of a colleague. Each is its assignee's to answer once, on the step's review form when the template names one (a FormResponse its FormInvitation locks) with a written summary and, for the reviewer, a rating; submission locks it. A step returned (by the reviewer or development, with the reason) is waiting again; a step cancelled names why (feedback withdrawn, its giver left, the review excluded). The state is audit-logged.

field.name: partyId
field.description: Who answers it; empty for a reviewer's step with no reviewer yet

field.name: summary
field.description: The written assessment or feedback

field.name: requestedByPartyId
field.description: Feedback: who asked for it

entity.description: A reviewer's private note on a review (refined from the sketch, F6): read and changed only by its author, never by the person, a later reviewer, development, HR or an approver; never in the released review, an export, Chatter, a notification, the search index or a model's input (ai-opt-out). Written through store#ReviewNote.

field.name: partyId
field.description: The person reviewed

entity.description: A file of a review (IronStone People PE-01): evidence the review's people share. The review is People's content host, so the file is never on the person's broadly visible Party record; get#RecordLinkInfo and RecordFiles admit it only to the review's reviewer and development readers of its employer, and to the person once the review is released (mantle.humanres.ReviewServices.check#ReviewAccess); no Records-drive folder maps it. Written through mantle.humanres.ReviewServices.create#ReviewContent.

A goal's measure and owner, keyed by its WorkEffort (IronStone People design §11 Goals, PE-16): a WorkEffort of the WetGoal type and the WepGoal purpose (its title, description, period in estimatedStartDate and estimatedCompletionDate, percentComplete and state: WeInProgress open, WeComplete closed with its outcome, WeCancelled), never a WetTask, so it is in no task list (CalDAV Tasks, Today's and My tasks), no project and no search index. The measure: what is measured, the target and the actual value with their unit, and the outcome agreed when it closes; the parent goal is the WorkEffort's parentWorkEffortId. Read by the person, the manager of a live reporting line at the employer, the reviewer of the review it was agreed in and development readers of the employer; changed by the person, that manager and development editors (store#Goal). A linked task's completion is evidence, never the goal met.

field.name: partyId
field.description: Whose goal it is

field.name: performanceReviewId
field.description: The review it was agreed in, if any
